trailhead.label: Isola, at the foot of the consortium road to Cà Raseri, the board’s start

cautions: The consortium road above Isola is open to cars with a permit: keep your dog close on the hairpins.
Cattle graze the Alpe Borghetto and the pastures above in summer: keep your distance and your dog on a short lead.
A long climb of over 1,000 m with open ground above 1,900 m; storms build fast on summer afternoons.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
